name: stremio-tv-plugin-live-tv
description: Live TV plugin for stremio-tv: channels, scrapers, and HLS relay, loaded as a dropped-in StremioTvPlugin

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && mv dist/plugin.js dist/plugin.mjs && cp plugin.json dist/plugin.json && tsc -p tsconfig.scrapers.json
scripts.test: node test/scraper-config.mjs && node test/github-import.mjs && node test/channels.mjs && node test/codecs.mjs && node test/reputation.mjs && node test/scrapers.mjs && node test/rails.mjs && node test/default-scraper.mjs
